LanguageData.SmoothDragSelect_ThrottleEnabledTip: Rate-limits full UI passes caused by MouseDrag/MouseMove events: up to 60Hz at healthy frame rates, tightening to 10Hz when frames degrade. Disable to compare with vanilla behavior.
LanguageData.SmoothDragSelect_ProfilingEnabledTip: Writes slow-frame breakdowns (update/ticks/mapUpdate/drawMapMesh/drawDynamicThings/guiPhase) and per-drag statistics to the game log. For diagnosis only.
